primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-irreducible-group-scheme-over-field-qc (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1131-1135

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: quasi-compactness can be checked after a field extension (surjectivity of G_K -> G) and irreducibility persists (047M), so one passes to an algebraically closed extension of very large cardinality making G Jacobson with rational closed points (0479); then for a nonempty affine U and any g in G(k) the opens gU and U meet (G irreducible), so g lies in the image of (u1, u2) -> u1 u2^{-1}; that image is open (047K) and contains every rational point, hence is all of G by Jacobson density of rational closed points; G is the image of the affine (hence quasi-compact) U x U (source lines 1137-1163)
